environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in shared VPC. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile. Task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/ProcessorTaskRole has s3:PutObject on the output bucket. Multiple containers from different tenants share the same ECS task definition and /tmp is backed by a shared EFS mount (fs-0a1b2c3d4e) mounted at /tmp/processing with no access point isolation. No SCP applied to the account. No permission boundary on the task role.
